title: Ka Persara Ki Sur Khasi (The Fragrant Garden of Khasi Melodies)
cultural_context: Lyrical ballad in classical Khasi celebrating the blossoming flowers (*ki persara syntiew*) and mountain breezes of Meghalaya.

khasi: Ha ka persara ki sur ba thiang,
Ki syntiew ki phuh ha rynsan ka ri,
Ka duitara ka tied ia u ksai ba tyngshain,
Ban pynbyrngia ia ka mynsiem ba dap da ka jingsuk.
english: Within the fragrant garden of sweet melodies,
The blossoms unfold upon the terraces of the homeland,
The four-stringed duitara plucks its shining cord,
To bring serene solace to the soul filled with peace.

vocabulary.ksai-tyngshain: glistening resonant string of the harp
